import triton
import triton.language as tl



@triton.autotune(
    configs=[

        triton.Config({'XBLOCK': 64,  'BLOCK_R': 64}, num_warps=8,  num_stages=1),
        triton.Config({'XBLOCK': 128, 'BLOCK_R': 64}, num_warps=8,  num_stages=2),
        triton.Config({'XBLOCK': 256, 'BLOCK_R': 64}, num_warps=16, num_stages=2),
        triton.Config({'XBLOCK': 512, 'BLOCK_R': 64}, num_warps=16, num_stages=2),

)

    x_offsets = x_start + tl.arange(0, XBLOCK)
    x_mask = x_offsets < xnumel
